target_product.review_text:
Rose water is one of those flavors that you either really enjoy or really hate. I'm in the enjoy category, and this hits the mark when it comes to flavor. It's a light rose flavor and aroma -- enough to be pleasant, but not so much that it's overpowering. It's good as-is or as a drink mixer that adds a unique flavor beyond what you'd get with a tonic water or club soda.

It comes in glass bottles, which is a plus. While it makes the 6 pack rather weighty, glass is easier to recycle than plastic. The glass is sturdy and, despite very little packaging, the 6-pack arrived in perfect shape.

My only con is the carbonation level. It's heavier than I would have preferred for drinking this right out of the bottle. I would have liked it to be more along the lines of a sparkling water-level carbonation rather than a soft drink-level carbonation. But, if you're using this as a mixer, the heavy carbonation probably would work well.

It's pricey, but given that it's a unique drink I think the price is not out of range. One star down for the carbonation level, but otherwise a good option if you enjoy rose water.
target_product.review_title: Light floral flavor and aroma; bit too heavy on the carbonation
